name: Acousto-Optic Modulator R-Factor Analysis
definition: A design procedure to evaluate AOM performance by calculating the R-factor (ratio of acoustical beam spread to optical beam spread) and determining output beam eccentricity.
summary: Acousto-Optic Modulator R-Factor Analysis calculates the ratio of acoustical to optical beam spread to determine output beam eccentricity, distinguishing itself by focusing on intrinsic modulator beam shaping rather than scanner channel alignment.
